sections.title: Purpose 11
paragraphs: It is the purpose of these Bylaws to implement the Chelsea Town Plan by providing for 13 the appropriate use of all lands in the Town of Chelsea in a manner which will: 14 * promote and protect the public health, safety, prosperity, comfort, convenience, 16 efficiency, and general welfare; 17 * protect soils, forests, stream banks, wetlands, and other natural resources; 19 * encourage the density and distribution of settlement to be in character with the 21 rural residential environment of the town; 22 * and further the purposes set forth in Section 4302 of the Act. 24

subsections.title: Notice of Violations 12
paragraphs: No action may be brought under this section unless the alleged offender has had at least 14 seven (7) days' warning notice by certified mail that a violation exists, as required under 15 the Act [S4451]. The notice of violation also shall be recorded in the land records of the 16 municipality under Section 5.3. The notice shall state that a violation exists, that the 17 alleged offender has an opportunity to cure the violation within the seven-day notice 18 period, and that the alleged offender will not be entitled to an additional warning notice 19 for a violation occurring after the seven days. Action may be brought without notice and 20 opportunity to cure if the alleged offender repeats the violation of the regulations after the 21 seven-day notice period and within the next succeeding 12 months. 22
